economy.summary: Joined the Pennsylvania House Republican 'Freedom Through Affordability' initiative, a package of proposals to reduce costs for families that includes a temporary personal income tax reduction, a six-month suspension of the gross receipts tax on electricity and telecommunications, a gas tax suspension, and sales tax holidays on car seats and baby products; his office lists him among the members sponsoring the tax-relief proposals.
economy.short: Sponsors tax-relief proposals in House GOP family cost-cutting package.

taxes.summary: Voted against the $50.85 billion 2026-27 state budget, saying it 'still spends more than taxpayers can afford' and that delayed payments only push funding obligations into the next year; he noted the budget does not raise taxes or tap the Rainy Day Fund and said the best path forward is to grow the economy and grow revenues without raising taxes.
taxes.short: Voted against 2026-27 budget, saying spending exceeds taxpayers' means.

abortion.summary: His campaign site says he holds firm pro-life values and dedicates himself to the defense of all citizens' rights, including those of the unborn.
abortion.short: Campaign site states pro-life values, defending rights of the unborn.

education.summary: His campaign site says he supports parental rights within the educational system and opposes restrictions on parents' rights in education.
education.short: Supports parental rights in education, opposes restricting them.

healthcare.summary: His campaign site describes him as a proponent of medical freedom; the site does not detail specific healthcare policy proposals.
healthcare.short: Campaign site calls him proponent of medical freedom; no specifics.

energy.summary: In his statement on the 2026-27 state budget, he cited Pennsylvania's withdrawal from the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, along with permitting reform, among Republican achievements from the previous year's budget that he credited with generating additional revenue; this appears in a budget statement rather than a broader energy platform.
energy.short: Cites RGGI withdrawal and permitting reform as budget achievements.

guns.summary: His campaign site describes him as a staunch advocate for both gun ownership and public safety and says he introduced legislation to defund sanctuary cities while strengthening firearm owner rights. In 2024 he accepted the Gun Owners of America endorsement, saying he was eager to join the fight to secure Second Amendment rights across the Commonwealth.
guns.short: Advocates gun ownership rights; introduced firearm-owner-rights legislation.
